title: Validation failures return 422 instead of the conventional 400
evidence: lib/book_api/router.ex:37 returns {422, ...} for invalid input; TASK.md/R9 how_to_verify expects rejection with 400
suggestion: Return 400 Bad Request for missing required fields to match the spec's expected status code

title: SQL built via string interpolation rather than parameterized queries
evidence: lib/book_api/store.ex:11,18,22 interpolate values into SQL; sql_quote (store.ex:47) escapes single quotes so basic injection is mitigated, but it is not parameterized
suggestion: Use a real SQLite driver (e.g. exqlite/ecto_sqlite3) with bound parameters instead of shelling out with interpolated SQL

title: Persistence shells out to the sqlite3 CLI binary rather than a library driver
evidence: lib/book_api/store.ex:35,44 call System.cmd("sqlite3", ...); requires the sqlite3 executable to be on PATH at runtime
suggestion: Consider a Hex SQLite driver for portability; current approach works where sqlite3 is installed (documented in README.md:3)
